The survey sampled approximately 24,000 students in grades 8, 10, and 12 across 235 schools, using a self-administered questionnaire with a response rate of 82 percent. Past-year use of any illicit drug other than cannabis was reported by 4.9 percent of 12th graders, essentially unchanged from the prior year and below pre-2020 levels. Past-month nicotine vaping declined by about 1.3 percentage points among 10th graders (p < 0.05). Prevalence estimates were weighted to adjust for school-level nonresponse and are accompanied by 95 percent confidence intervals. Because the survey relies on self-report, underreporting is possible, particularly for stigmatized behaviors, and students who are absent or have left school are not represented.
